'''Earth Blast''' is an [[Earth spells|earth]]-based [[Blast spells|blast spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 53 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest earth spell available to [[free-to-play]] players.

== Damage==
Earth Blast's base maximum hit starts at 15 and increases to 16 when the player unlocks [[Fire Blast]] at level 59 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Earth Blast's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an earth-based spell, Earth Blast's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to earth]].

== Notable uses ==

* During the [[Family Crest]] quest, the player must deal damage to the demon [[Chronozon]] with Earth Blast (along with each of the other three blast spells) at least once in order to defeat it.
